payload.summary: Nine outdated packages in **web-app**. I ran the test suite against each upgrade on its own branch.

groups.title: Safe: tests pass, no API changes

items.title: react 19.1.0 → 19.2.0
items.body: Bug fixes only. All 412 tests pass.

items.title: vite 7.0.4 → 7.1.2
items.body: Faster cold starts. Build output is byte-identical.

items.title: eslint 9.30 → 9.33
items.body: Two new rules, both off by default.

items.title: zod 3.25 → 4.1
items.body: Major version. 14 call sites use `.nonempty()`, which is removed; I have a codemod ready.

items.title: date-fns 3.6 → 4.1
items.body: Time zone support moved into the core package. Two imports change.

items.title: @tanstack/react-query 5 → 6 (beta)
items.body: Only a beta is published. Two tests fail on the new suspense behaviour.
